description: Three sheets, still on the board

participation.context: Looked at the three sheets and left them on the board.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the last lines and did not write a next one. The coffer stayed shut.

title: Left the sheets where they were

participation.context: Spoke the news at the window and kept the door shut.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You repeated the telling once, asked who sold the sellers their butter, and did not go to see. You did not write the crowd into the sheets.

title: Said the butter was sold at threepence and stayed at the window
